checkpoints.step: Then the agent reviews:
checkpoints.expected: � Original DDS determination: SoC-APPR-NE-07 (NOT ELIGIBLE � weather) � Passenger dispute: Claims weather classification is incorrect � Agent investigates: - Reviews Departure delay code 77 (Weather) - Checks if code was correctly assigned - Reviews operational logs - Determines if override is warranted

checkpoints.step: Then the agent determines: Override decision is PENDING
checkpoints.expected: � Agent needs additional information before making a decision � Agent may need to: - Contact operations team for clarification on Departure delay code - Review weather reports for the date/time - Consult with supervisor on borderline cases - Request additional documentation from passenger � Case remains in PENDING OVERRIDE status

checkpoints.step: Then the agent updates the case:
checkpoints.expected: Investigating Departure delay code accuracy. Awaiting operations team response. Your dispute is under review. We will update you once our investigation is complete.
